ns2:section.sectionText: Digital marketing has completely changed the way businesses connect with their customer base. This course exams strategies and campaigns within the digital landscape and the role of social media. Students will learn how to collect and analyze digital analytics. Students will prepare for and earn professional accreditation in analytics and search. RECOMMENDED: Proficiency in Microsoft Excel. Students are required to login and use Compass (compass2g.illinois.edu) in order to complete this course.
